run_flat_scene_generation: run the script to generate N flat Minecraft scenes and pickle them to a target directory
run_with_custom_count: run the script with --N flag to generate a specific number of flat scenes
run_with_target_path: run the script with --target flag to specify the output directory for flat_scenes_dump.pk
review_template_attributes: review the template_attributes dict that configures count, step, mob names, block types, and action distribution
review_distribution_weights: review the action distribution weights for MOVE, BUILD, DESTROY, DIG, COPY, FILL, SPAWN, and DANCE
